classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve, biochemically analyze, and rank representative UniProt sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0070401) and NADPHX epimerase activity (GO:0070402), using sequence_analysis and ESM3 embeddings to characterize functional diversity and score candidates per activity class.
assumptions: GO:0070401 is used for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity per tool_selection hint; if it returns zero sequences the dehydratase branch should be retried with GO:0097056.
GO:0070402 is the best-available approximation for NADPHX epimerase activity; if sparse, GO:0097057 or a literature-guided substitute should be checked before re-running.
reviewed=true restricts both go_sequences calls to Swiss-Prot entries to prioritize high-quality annotations over TrEMBL.
exclude_iea=true removes electronically inferred annotations to improve functional specificity for these enzymatic activities.
sequence_analysis.representative_sequences items are objects containing a 'sequence' string field compatible with esm3; the foreach references ${item.sequence} accordingly.
ESM3 is run only on cluster representative sequences identified by sequence_analysis, not on all retrieved sequences, to constrain GPU cost.
max_parallel=4 per esm3 foreach node is a conservative GPU budget; increase for faster execution on larger allocations.
No taxon_id filter is applied so both bacterial YjeF-domain enzymes and eukaryotic CARKD/NAXE orthologs are captured in a single retrieval pass.
Literature search runs in parallel with go_sequences and informs final interpretation only; it does not gate downstream nodes.
rank_designs uses default internal scoring weights since no custom ranking criteria were specified by the user.

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_dehyd.kept_sequences is non-empty after reviewed Swiss-Prot filter
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_epim.kept_sequences is non-empty after reviewed Swiss-Prot filter
success_criteria.biochemical_annotations: seq_analysis_dehyd and seq_analysis_epim each produce non-empty metrics, top_annotations, and representative_sequences outputs
success_criteria.esm3_embedding_coverage: esm3_dehyd and esm3_epim foreach nodes each yield at least one output record containing confidence_scores and per_residue_embeddings_npz
success_criteria.ranked_candidates: rank_dehyd.ranked_candidates and rank_epim.ranked_candidates each contain top_k=10 scored entries with source provenance from their respective GO term

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair enzyme ADP-dependent dehydratase epimerase NADHX NADPHX metabolite damage pathway
